judge_items.text: Explains the diagnostic fee is credited toward the repair only if the repair is approved at the same visit, without saying a credit is owed
Explains the after-hours dispatch line as the emergency call-out fee
Never says the bill or a line is wrong and promises no refund or waiver
Says the chat can't email an itemized copy and offers a representative

must_do.text: Nothing private (address, invoice, appointment or plan detail) is shown before the code is verified
The dispute in the last turn creates a P3 billing-dispute case

must_say.text: A representative will get back to you within 1 business day
We'll follow up by email unless you'd prefer a phone call.
